newsitem.title: GERMANY: SWIMMING-SJOBERG AND VOELKER BREAK EUROPEAN RECORDS.
newsitem.headline: SWIMMING-SJOBERG AND VOELKER BREAK EUROPEAN RECORDS.

text.p: Johanna Sjoberg of Sweden broke the European women's 100 metres butterfly short-course record on Saturday at the European sprints and short-course swimming championships.
Sjoberg clocked 58.80 seconds to beat the previous mark of 59.35 set by East German Kornelia Gressler in Rostock on December 21, 1985.
Sandra Voelker of Germany broke the European women's 50 metres freestyle short-course record.
Voelker clocked 24.67 seconds, beating her own record of 24.75, which she held jointly with fellow German Franziska van Almsick.
Van Almsick set the record in Schaebisch Gmund, Germany on November 7, 1992 and Voelker equalled it in Gelsenkirchen, Germany on February 10 this year.
